summary: Docs site: code-tab language selector broken on Streaming guide (tabs not switching / wrong snippet shown)
description:
Issue summary:
The language selector (code tabs) on the Streaming guide page is intermittently broken. Clicking tabs either:
- does nothing (tab UI changes but code block does not update), or
- updates the highlighted tab but shows the wrong language snippet (e.g., selecting Go still shows TypeScript), or
- works once, then breaks after scrolling and coming back up.

Impact:
- Internal: DevEx/docs refresh is shipping updated streaming + tool-calling examples this week; broken tabs undercut copy/paste success.
- External: Users report confusion because examples appear inconsistent across languages even when content is correct.
- Support load risk: users opening tickets due to “TS sample doesn’t compile” when they were viewing the wrong language snippet.

Where observed:
- Primary: /guides/streaming (new Streaming guide page)
- Also seen on: /guides/tool-calling when multiple code groups are present

Suspected cause:
Client-side code-tab selector state isn’t properly scoped per code-group instance. It looks like the tab click handler is targeting the first matching code-group on the page (duplicate IDs/data attributes), and hydration reorders nodes so selectors drift after navigation/scroll.

Repro steps (Chrome 121 / macOS):
1) Open docs in a fresh session: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/streaming
2) Scroll to the first section that has tabbed code samples (Python/TypeScript/Go)
3) Click TypeScript, then Go
4) Observe: the tab highlight changes, but the code snippet may not update OR it updates to the wrong language
5) Scroll down to a later section with another tabbed code block, repeat
6) Navigate away (e.g., sidebar to Structured Output) and back to Streaming; tabs break more consistently after client-side navigation

Expected:
Each tab group should switch only its own snippet, consistently, across navigation and scrolling.

Actual:
Tab UI and code snippet selection go out of sync, and selection leaks across groups.

Notes:
This is separate from content parity; the snippet content appears correct in source MDX, but the UI selector is applying incorrectly at runtime.

Links:
- Slack context: sources/slack/docs/1738920044-docs-page-redirects-and-deprecations.json
- Related work stream: streaming examples refresh (ENG-4826 / PM-412)
comments: 2025-02-11 10:22 PST — Wei Chen (Reporter): Noticed during final pass on the Streaming guide before publishing. Tabs look correct but the snippet is wrong after toggling a couple times. Repro above. This will make the cross-language parity work look broken even when it isn’t.

2025-02-11 11:05 PST — Elliot Price (Assignee): Confirmed. I can reproduce reliably after client-side nav (sidebar click) and then toggling Go/Python twice. Looks like event handler is selecting first code group instance (querySelector) and not scoping to the clicked group. Looping in Docs Eng.

2025-02-11 12:18 PST — Kira Thompson: Adding an internal note: this impacts the DX standards pages too (multiple tab sets). If fix is generic, please verify on at least 2 pages with multiple code blocks.

2025-02-12 09:40 PST — Elliot Price: Fix in progress: make tab state local to each code group component; remove reliance on duplicated DOM IDs; use event.currentTarget + closest('.code-group') scoping; ensure MDX renders unique keys. Will add a small Playwright check for ‘click tab updates code text’ on Streaming guide.

2025-02-13 14:12 PST — Elliot Price: PR opened: sources/github/redwood-docs/pr-534-fix-broken-code-tab-selector.json. Includes:
- scoping tab toggles to nearest code group
- removing global querySelector usage
- ensuring unique data attributes per group
- regression test: click tabs on /guides/streaming and verify code block contains expected import line for each language
Requesting review from Wei + Design for UX.

2025-02-13 16:03 PST — Wei Chen: Validated on preview deploy from PR-534:
- Streaming page: first and second tabbed blocks switch correctly and independently
- After sidebar navigation away/back: still correct
- No cross-group leakage observed
One nit: the copy button still works and copies the visible snippet (good).

2025-02-14 09:22 PST — Elliot Price: Merged PR-534. Scheduling deploy with docs publish window. Will monitor for any residual hydration issues and check analytics for unusual bounce on Streaming guide.
2025-02-14 13:45 PST — Connor O'Brien: Deploy completed to production. Confirmed on docs.redwoodinference.com in incognito. Closing ticket.
resolution: Fixed code-tab selector scoping per code-group instance and added a UI regression test. Rolled out via redwood-docs PR-534; verified on preview and in production post-deploy.
rollout_notes: Deployed as part of the docs refresh publish window on 2025-02-14. No customer action required. Monitor: support ticket trend for “wrong language snippet” and docs page interactions on /guides/streaming for 48 hours.
acceptance_criteria: On /guides/streaming, each code-tab group switches its own snippet correctly for Python/TypeScript/Go.
Switching tabs in one group does not affect other code-tab groups on the same page.
Behavior is stable after client-side navigation and scrolling.
Copy button copies the currently visible snippet.
A regression test exists to prevent recurrence.
